rnb_1945.csv.note: Caldonia, Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five, Decca, May 1945. It reached R&B number 1. Jordan's jump blues sat on the R&B chart, so it is filed here rather than with the Chicago blues.

rnb_1948.csv.note: Good Rockin' Tonight, King 4210, February 1948. Roy Brown wrote it and recorded it first. Wynonie Harris's cover reached R&B number 1. It is filed with the jump-blues records that led into R&B.

rnb_1949.csv.note: The Hucklebuck, Paul Williams and His Hucklebuckers, Savoy, 1949, reached R&B number 1. The label spells it The Hucklebuck. Saturday Night Fish Fry, Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five, Decca 24725, was recorded on August 9, 1949 and also reached R&B number 1. The order is a listening order, not a chart rank.
